caption: The drawing is on a slightly yellowed, off-white rectangular sheet of paper with a single black-ink outline of an object centered in the composition, surrounded by a thin black rectangular border. The object itself appears to be a cradle-like or tub-like form with a high, curved back at both ends, one end higher than the other, and an ornate patterned rim along the edge of the opening. The body of the object has a rounded, bulging shape, and it stands on four small spherical feet. There is a number “10” printed in black in the top left corner of the page, and a signature reading “C. Whistler” is present in the lower right quadrant of the drawing. Slight pencil marks or scribbles are faintly visible to the right of the object. The lines of the drawing are clean and uniform, and there is no shading or coloring within the object or on the background.
title: Study of Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
